name: card-field
title: Card Field
useCases: In a checkout prototype, a tester selects the built-in test card and resets it for the next run.
In a live checkout, a customer fills in Stripe Elements over HTTPS. The app uses onCompleteChange to decide when to offer payment confirmation.
task: Enter a test card number or mount a Stripe payment field.
behavior: In demo mode onChange receives test digits. For mode="payment", mount inside configured Stripe Elements over HTTPS and use onCompleteChange to track completion.
